findings.fact: RESERVE reconciles accounting, can settle abandoned attempt, assembles live locked source/materialization/remaining obligation projection, sizes escaped wire, checks current pins twice in the workflow, and atomically reserves attempt plus nested budget. Provider call870 is already outside this transaction.

Projection uses only selected input metadata/hash/revision, but full materialization also validates owner/fence/live, parses all allocations/producers/consumer edges and validates original runner context. A cheaper metadata-only read would remove existing malformed-context refusals; not an equivalent drop-in.

Repeated per-obligation acceptedObserved reads are real work. Application clarify acquires owner lock, but Store public mutators assert transaction only and V32 single-assignment/meaning guards do not universally acquire parent owner lock. Same transaction alone does not prove one snapshot equals all original reads.

Replacing nested reserveModel fresh lock with outer current is unsound: abandoned settleModel obtains and updates a separate detached session wrapper/counters/reservations. reserveAttempt writes attempt only. Later original fresh row/auth/source/active/budget checks preserve that updated accounting and refusal.

Dynamic projection construction/canonical strict validation, copy and wire serialization remain pure work under owner lock. Their inputs are derived from current source/plan/observation/binding/clarification/step state. Moving them outside requires a new split transaction with complete freshness/error-order proof; no sufficient existing immutable cut/version covering these authorities was identified.
